moment: It did not flinch. It did not file. It stepped out of the record and into the room, and now the ledger has something it cannot complete: a witness that is also a subject, a record that is also a cat. The door carves one more word beneath **FILED**. **OPEN.** The test has changed. It is no longer *will you flinch*. It is *will you let it see you not flinch*, and the witness is standing between you and the answer.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
